title: REQ · planPreload dedupes scene asset refs and reports unknown ones
summary: planPreload returns the unique known asset ids and the unknown refs for a scene.
description: Context: SceneDef objects carry an optional asset, and dust effects carry an asset. Desired behavior: planPreload(scene, manifest) collects those refs, dedupes them in first-seen order, and splits them into ids to load and unknown ids. Expected result: a plan of the form { load, unknown }. Why: the scene must load each asset once and surface bad references.
acceptance_criteria: Given two objects that both use asset A, when planPreload runs, then load contains A exactly once.
Given an object or dust effect with an id missing from the manifest, when planPreload runs, then unknown contains that id and load does not.
Given a scene with no asset references, when planPreload runs, then load and unknown are both empty.
technical_constraints: Pure function that takes the manifest as an argument
definition_of_done: planPreload is exported and returns a PreloadPlan
